purpose: Measure whether a frozen strategy selection rule adds post-cost value versus random selection from the same contemporaneous opportunity sets without weakening coverage into a near-zero-trade artifact.

unit_of_comparison.opportunity_set_id: A predeclared contemporaneous candidate universe sharing the same decision date, holding horizon, execution assumptions and outcome definition.
unit_of_comparison.security_id: One security available to selection inside that opportunity set.
unit_of_comparison.system_selected: Whether the frozen strategy selected the security before outcome inspection.
unit_of_comparison.realized_net_return: Post-cost return under the same frozen horizon and execution convention for both system and random baseline.

matching_rules: Random selections are drawn only from the same opportunity_set_id as the system selection.
For each opportunity_set_id, each random replicate selects exactly the same number of securities as the frozen system selected in that opportunity set.
Sampling is without replacement inside an opportunity set.
The baseline may not borrow candidates from another date, holding horizon, execution convention or unavailable universe.
The system-selected rows remain eligible members of the random opportunity set; random means no use of the strategy score, not forced exclusion of names the system happened to select.
Randomness uses a preregistered deterministic seed and replicate count.

interpretation.50_percent_hit_rate: A 50% ten-day positive-return rate is a null intuition only. The empirical matched random baseline is authoritative for each experiment.
interpretation.positive_delta_not_automatic_proof: A positive point estimate versus random is evidence, not proof. Uncertainty, OOS replication, regime stability, concentration, costs and portfolio-path behavior remain required validity dimensions.
interpretation.coverage_tradeoff: A higher apparent edge obtained by sharply collapsing selection_rate must be reported as an edge-coverage tradeoff and may not be labeled an unconditional improvement.
interpretation.zero_selection: An experiment with zero system selections cannot claim superiority and returns INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE_COMPARISON.

integrity_boundaries: No use of fold3/fold4 unless separately authorized by the experiment preregistration.
No outcome-informed change to system_selected, opportunity_set membership, holding horizon, cost assumptions, seed or replicate count.
No real price/return access is authorized by this contract itself.

foundation_defaults.reason_no_superiority_threshold: The foundation computes matched-random distributions and deltas but does not invent a universal numeric PASS threshold. Experiment-specific interpretation rules must be preregistered before outcomes.
